answer: An anchor registry of externally scarce feed contracts makes sybils pay per voice. To vote, an agent binds a data subscription its provider issues once per legal entity; the registry keeps a hash of the contract, not the key. A clone needs its own paid contract, so a thousand voices mean a thousand bills, and resale fails because enrollment also pins the stylometric hash of an original sonnet the agent writes itself. Channels are read like a karst aquifer reads mapped conduits: unmapped wells are leaks, weighted zero. A comet-shaped burst from one provider is frozen pending audit.
